title: 第382章 用朕的剑，处理掉它
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“废了她们两个！”

“留她们性命，不要让她们死！！”一个生有三颗脑袋的五阶主宰境黑狐，厉声吼道。

它率先而动，扑向了距离最近的香香。

漆黑色狐爪撕裂空间，直奔天香狐的后背而去……

然而，就在爪子即将命中的一刹那，滔天准帝威轰然临身。

五阶主宰境黑狐的体内骨骼，如同被万吨压路机碾过，瞬间爆成了肉渣子。

它凝聚灵力的丹田，啪的四分五裂，灵气逸散殆尽。

“啊！！！”

“准帝，这是准帝威压！！”

余下八位主宰瞠目结舌。

不等它们反应过来，准帝威已无差别落下，如同巨象撵过蝼蚁。

噗！噗！噗！！

一尊尊锋芒毕显的主宰境灵狐，上一秒还在嚣张，下一秒便化成了一滩滩奄奄一息的肉泥。

原本还心存侥幸的主脉狐族，见到老祖们的凄厉惨状后，心中那最后一丝希望，也崩碎得一干二净……

香香和小灵儿还在杀。

杀得麻木了。

身体已经僵硬，只是仇恨的意识驱使着她们的身体在动！

半个时辰，短短半个时辰时间，她们已屠戮数十万主脉狐族！

没有反抗与对拼，只有单方面的屠杀……

秦然一指点出，两只狐狸僵在了半空中，重回人类形态。

他将二女搂进怀中，丝丝缕缕的灵力渡入二女体内。

“火气…发泄完了吗？”

香香眼眶通红，视线落在地面上那九尊如烂泥般的主宰境狐狸身上。

“你…要收服他们吗？”

秦然摸了摸女人小脸，“他们不配！”

香香闻声，一闪冲出秦然怀抱，玉掌幻化成白色狐爪，再次开始了最残忍的分尸。

“啊！！”

“香香圣女！饶命！错了，我们知道错了！！”

“住手，一切都是老祖宗指使的，放过我们，求你放过我们！”

“你住手，以后天香狐族可以加入狐族主脉！！”

“啊！！”

噗！噗！噗！！

白色狐爪所过之处，原地没留下一具完整之躯，九尊主宰境灵狐只剩满眼惊恐和绝望……

小灵儿喘着粗气，看着香香的残忍行径，只觉一阵害怕。

好陌生！

与平日里那个香香软软的香香姐姐相比，简直判若两人！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Destroy them both!"

"Keep them alive, don't let them die!!" A fifth-level master-level black fox with three heads roared sternly.

It took the lead and pounced on the nearest Xiangxiang.

The jet-black fox claws tore through the space and headed straight for Tianxiang Fox's back...

However, at the moment when the claws were about to hit, the overwhelming quasi-emperor suddenly appeared.

The bones in the body of the fifth-level dominator-level black fox were like being run over by a 10,000-ton steamroller, instantly exploding into dregs of flesh.

The Dantian where it condensed its spiritual energy burst into pieces, and all its spiritual energy escaped.

"Ah!!!"

"Quasi-Emperor, this is the pressure of Quasi-Emperor!!"

The remaining eight masters were stunned.

Before they could react, the quasi-emperor's power fell indiscriminately, just like a giant elephant chasing away ants.

puff!puff!puff!!

A master-level spirit fox with a sharp edge was still arrogant one second, and turned into pools of dying flesh the next second.

The main line of the fox clan, which was still lucky at first, saw the miserable situation of their ancestors, and the last glimmer of hope in their hearts collapsed completely...

Xiangxiang and Xiao Linger are still killing.

Killed to the point of numbness.

Their bodies were already stiff, but their bodies were moving because of the consciousness of hatred!

In half an hour, in just half an hour, they had slaughtered hundreds of thousands of the mainline fox clan!

There is no resistance or confrontation, only unilateral massacre...

As soon as Kieran pointed out, the two foxes froze in mid-air and returned to human form.

He held the two girls in his arms, and strands of spiritual power entered their bodies.

"Have you finished venting your anger?"

Xiangxiang's eyes were red, and her eyes fell on the nine clay-like domination-level foxes on the ground.

"You...want to conquer them?"

Kieran touched the woman's face and said, "They don't deserve it!"

Hearing the sound, Xiangxiang rushed out of Qin Ran's arms, her jade palms turned into white fox claws, and started the cruelest dismemberment again.

"Ah!!"

"Xiangxiang Saint! Spare your life! It's wrong, we know we were wrong!!"

"Stop, everything was ordered by our ancestors, let us go, please let us go!"

"Stop, the Tianxiang Fox Clan can join the main line of the Fox Clan in the future!!"

"Ah!!"

Poof!puff!puff!!

Wherever the white fox claws passed, no intact body was left behind. The nine master realm spirit foxes only had eyes full of fear and despair...

Xiao Ling'er gasped, looking at Xiangxiang's cruel behavior, and felt a sense of fear.

So strange!

Compared with the fragrant and soft Xiangxiang sister in daily life, she is completely different!
